antlr4-python3-runtime.scope: Official PyPI source inspected: setuptools packages/bin pygrun only; no extensions, compiler calls, CUDA source or runtime imports in setup.py.

iopath.scope: Official PyPI setup.py + version.py inspected; setuptools Python package only, no extensions/compiler/GPU path.

compiler_wheel_origin.installation_scope: Install this complete official cp313 aarch64 wheel. The same-version PyPI build has different compiler libraries; do not swap individual native files.
compiler_wheel_origin.qualification_scope: Source-origin pin and CPU command checks only; numerical impact and fresh installation remain separate gates.
compiler_wheel_origin.upstream_source: Cosmos pyproject.toml tool.uv.sources.triton selects the pytorch index.

explicit_exclusions: Training, hardware robot drivers, visualization UI, vendor TensorRT builders, CUDA source compilation are not installed by this inference-only bootstrap.
FlashAttention/native acceleration remains a separately built and qualified dependency where selected.

openpi-client/openpi-server are required only by the upstream standalone websocket main(); InstinctFlash uses its own public websocket server and calls the native policy class directly. They are not imported by that policy module at import time.

native_tool.scope: Fresh isolated hf1.16.4 closure of23 pinned packages, native uvx unchanged, offline runtime reuse; model weights are prepared separately.

packaging_patch.scope: Packaging metadata only. Explicit inference dependencies replace training/UI/native-build requirements and incompatible historical Torch pins. Runtime source files are unchanged; actual inference remains an independent gate.
